# Design Field 2 (Craft CMS 6) - llms.txt

Flat reference. Full prose is in README.md. Field type: wmd\designfield\fields\Design. Twig variable: craft.designField.

## Stored value
JSON object, group handle => option key: {"variant":"cards","tone":"surface","columns":"4"}. Keys only, never CSS.
GraphQL: JSON string of the same shape, read and write.
Invalid keys are rejected on save (validation error "<key> is not an option of <group>").
MCP (Craft's own server): elements_get returns {option: key} for the options the block has; elements_field_schema lists each option as a string enum of its keys (additionalProperties false); elements_update takes the same object on the block or nested in a Matrix field's input (entries[].{type}.design). Write back the whole object: missing options fall back to their defaults. Unknown option, key outside the enum or a non-object: refused, message names the option. json_encode(DesignValue) = the stored object.

Condition rule (field layout "Show when"): wmd\designfield\fields\conditions\DesignVariantConditionRule, label "Design → Variant"; config {class, fieldUid, layoutElementUid, operator: in|ni|empty|notempty, values: [variant keys], uid}; matches the variant key of the element's Design value (unsaved choice included; `_default` when none picked; no variant group = empty); element conditions only, not query conditions.

## Twig
craft.designField.of(block: Element|array|DesignValue, profile: ?string = null): DesignValue - Design field value, or old option fields / mock map read leniently
craft.designField.value(keys: array, profile: ?string = null): DesignValue - strict value from a plain map
craft.designField.groups(): Group[] - every configured group
DesignValue.<group> / .get(group): Token - unknown groups give an empty Token
DesignValue.has(group): bool - whether the active profile includes the group
DesignValue.classes(...groups): string - joined classes; no args = every profile group
DesignValue.keys(): array<string,string>
Token.key, Token.label, Token.isDefault, Token.isAuto(): bool, Token.keyOr(fallback): string, Token.classOr(fallback): string, Token.get(part): string, (string)Token = all parts joined

## Config (config/craft/design-field.php; token files in config/designtokens/)
fieldMap: old field handle => group handle
groups.<handle>: label, instructions, tokens | options, default, auto, aliases, input (buttons|select|swatches|tiles|position|slider|toggle; toggle needs exactly two options, off first), iconsOnly, columns, showIf {group: [keys]} | variants [keys], optionMeta {key: {label, icon, swatch, swatchText, percent, image, description, sample}}
presets.<profile|*>.<label>: {group: key, ...} - one-click sets of choices above a block's options; profile presets first, then `*`; only groups the block has are applied; nothing extra is stored
the config file is the whole configuration; the settings page (below) only reads
option: key => "classes" | {label, icon (Craft icon name or inline SVG), swatch (CSS colour/gradient; "a|b" splits the chip), swatchText (text colour, drawn as "Aa" on the swatch), percent (width bar: 75, 75%, 0.75), image, description, sample (CSS font-size for an "Aa" button), <part>: "classes"}
position: cells `columns` to a row; keys naming a set lay themselves out (top-left..bottom-right nine-point grid, four corners, left/center/right row, top/middle/bottom column)
slider: Craft range control; the editor posts {"__slider": {handle: place}}, stored as the option key
profiles.<name>: list of group handles; 'group' => 'key' sets the default; 'group' => [overrides] adjusts a shared group; 'group' => [options|tokens ...] defines a local group
tileSkip: CSS selector of elements on the preview page left out of a tile picture
blockPreviewUrl: '/path?type={type}&design={design}' - a site page that renders one block of entry type {type} with the choices in {design} (JSON, option handle => key; set with block.setFieldValue('design', design) for that render); see examples/block-preview.twig
groupOverrides.<group>: settings merged into a group everywhere (survives regeneration)
profileOverrides.<profile>.<group>: settings for one profile only
profile matching: field setting > "<matrixField>:<type>" > "<type>" > "*" > every group

## Console
php artisan design-field:check [--json] - configuration check and template check; exit 1 when there is something to fix
php artisan design-field:schema [--markdown] [--agents=FILE [--check]] - the option model as JSON or markdown; --agents writes it between <!-- design-field:start/end --> markers
php artisan design-field:usage [--types=a,b] [--all] [--min=N] [--sample=N] [--months=N] [--json] - which choices editors use: never-changed, one-value, used; unused options

## Settings page (control panel: settings/plugins/design-field, admins only, saves no setting, opens with admin changes off)
?tab=configuration (default) - the findings of design-field:check: configuration check and template check
?tab=preview&block=<profile> - the real Design panel of that block (defaults, presets), nothing saved; unknown or no block shows the one with the most options; with blockPreviewUrl the block itself in a frame beside it (desktop 1280 / tablet 768 / mobile 375), reloaded on each change
Make tile pictures (button on ?tab=preview; block with a `variant` group, blockPreviewUrl and tileImages set, admin changes allowed) - draws each layout without a picture from blockPreviewUrl with design={"variant": key} to a 480 px JPEG in the browser and posts it to design-field/tiles/save, which writes tileImages ({type}/{key}.jpg under the web root)
?tab=usage - nothing is counted until &run=1; &months=12|6|3 limits it to entries saved in that period; one row per block (never changed, always the same choice); a run without months refreshes the "Most used" counts

## Not in 2.x (1.x only)
settings page tabs Looks, Presets and Tidy up; import/adopt/migrate

## Events
wmd\designfield\events\DefinePanelGroups (Laravel event; Craft 5: Design::EVENT_DEFINE_PANEL_GROUPS): element, groups (replace a Group, e.g. ->withHidden([keys])), keys (read only), hiddenGroups[] (leave an option out of the panel; value kept)
